goal: Phase 1c (plan-verb) of campaign adversarial-planner: faberun plan orchestrates the planning pipeline into a frozen plan that never launches and can end contested, with approval through the campaign's open-question written by the one declared writer, and three deterministic eval cases prove no-autostart, contested and detached. Supersedes the remaining nodes of contract 1b after discovery-output-ingested and planning-contract-template landed. Spec: docs/campaigns/adversarial-planner/spec/SPEC.md.

definitionOfDone.text: plan, plan/ stage, command-surface, manual and field-ownership tests pass
npm run docs:check finds the manual current with the plan section
the pipeline runs on recordings, the operator override persists, contested ends without a contract, approval follows the policy through open-question, and nothing launches the frozen contract

taskPacket.objective: faberun plan <spec.md> --campaign <id> [--phase <n>] [--review-rounds 2] [--approve-below standard|high|none] [--runtime-defaults worker=<id>,judge=<id>] [--detach] [--json] runs the planning pipeline as successive one-node runs (draft, review, revise up to the round budget), then sizing, routing with the operator's defaults winning, and freeze into .runs/campaigns/<id>/plans/<phase>/; a plan whose last review still carries a critical finding ends contested with no contract; freezing never launches; approval follows the risk policy through the campaign's open-question and resolve; --detach survives the seat.
instructions: Evidence: the chain coordinator (src/campaign/chain.mjs driveCampaignChain) already launches runs with `run --detach` (src/cli/launch.mjs detachSelf) and classifies them (runProgress, classifyRunProgress); the campaign journal has open-question and question.resolved events (src/cli/campaign.mjs note/resolve); the stages live in src/plan/{spec,repo-facts,routing,sizing,freeze,template}.mjs. Read all of them before writing.

A first attempt of this node (contract 1b) passed its own tests but tripped the field-ownership ratchet: runPlanningPipeline appended `open-question` journal events itself, making it a second writer of a type `note` owns. Two acceptable designs, pick one and keep docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md truthful: (a) the pipeline records approval and contested questions through the existing note path -- export the note helper from src/cli/campaign.mjs (in scope now) or spawn `faberun campaign note --kind open-question` through src/cli/launch.mjs's spawn pattern -- so the writer set stays `note`; or (b) the pipeline writes the event directly and docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md declares `runPlanningPipeline` as a second writer of open-question, raising the ratchet count in test/campaign/field-ownership.test.mjs with the dated justification the document requires. Prefer (a): one writer per field is the rule the ratchet defends.

Change 1, src/plan/pipeline.mjs: `runPlanningPipeline({specPath, campaignId, phase, cwd, reviewRounds, approveBelow, runtimeDefaults, runtimes, launch, wait})` -- validate the spec (validateSpec; strict findings abort), collectRepoFacts -> plans/<phase>/repo-facts.json, build and launch the draft contract, wait for the run (poll status.json through runProgress/classifyRunProgress; timeouts come from the contract), read .runs/<run>/results/<node>.json and take discoveryOutput().plan (validatePlanOutput), then review; while the findings contain a critical and rounds remain, build a revise contract with the findings and repeat; when a critical remains after the last round write plans/<phase>/plan.json with status 'contested', the open findings and provenance, write no contract.json, and record a campaign open-question `plan-<phase>-contested`; otherwise applySizingRules, resolveRuntimes (node override > operator runtimeDefaults > table > discovery; the table is a small default exported from routing or template), freezePlan into plans/<phase>/ and record status 'frozen'. Approval: the plan's highest riskTier compared with approveBelow (standard approves plans with no high node; high approves everything; none approves nothing) -> either plan.json.approved = true or a campaign open-question `plan-<phase>-approval` whose resolve records approval; nothing here ever calls run on the frozen contract. Every launched run is an ordinary run, so its invocations land in usage.jsonl; the pipeline also appends a `plan.stage` line to plans/<phase>/pipeline.jsonl per stage for the operator.

Change 2, src/cli/plan.mjs and src/cli.mjs: the `plan` verb in COMMAND_OPTIONS (campaign, phase, review-rounds, approve-below, runtime-defaults, detach, json) dispatched to planCli; `--detach` uses detachSelf('plan', specPath, flags) with the same bootstrap-record wait `run --detach` uses; usage line in src/cli/brand.mjs renderUsage; `npm run docs` regenerates the manual and you author the section's prose; docs/CONCEPTS.md gains a paragraph on the planner.

Tests, test/cli/plan.test.mjs on the replay harness (see test/harnesses/replay-run.test.mjs and evals/fixtures for how recordings drive a run): the pipeline runs draft and review from recordings and freezes; 'operator override wins' (--runtime-defaults appears in the frozen contract's runtimeDefaults over the table); 'approval policy' (a plan with a high node under --approve-below standard writes the open-question and no approved flag; with high it approves); 'plan never autostarts' (no .runs/<frozen contract id>/ exists after the pipeline ends); 'contested plan writes no contract' (recordings with a critical finding in every round). Keep each test's recordings small.
decisions: Runs, not nodes, are the pipeline's unit, so every planner invocation is accounted like any other.
Approval reuses open-question and resolve; no new journal event type.
The frozen contract is never launched by this command.
nonGoals: No live model anywhere in tests.
No change to the chain coordinator.
No spec-authoring verb (the template can build those contracts; a verb for them is a later decision).

taskPacket.objective: Three deterministic eval cases on the replay harness prove the planner's guarantees -- D23 a frozen plan never autostarts, D24 a contested plan emits no contract and names its findings, D25 a detached planning pipeline survives the death of the process that launched it -- each with a discriminator mutation, run by `node evals/run.mjs --case D23|D24|D25`.
instructions: Evidence: evals/deterministic/D01..D22 are contract-driven cases (case.json with contract, recordings, setup, discriminator; evals/case.mjs materializeCase; evals/run.mjs runs the contract and compares with expected.json). The planner is driven by a command, not a contract, so evals/run.mjs needs a case kind that runs `faberun plan` with replay runtimes; read evals/README.md and evals/case.mjs first.

Change 1, evals/case.mjs and evals/run.mjs: a case whose case.json carries `command: {argv: [...], env?: {...}}` instead of `contract` is materialised the same way (temp git repo, recordings on the replay harness) and run through src/cli.mjs with that argv; expected.json may assert files that exist or do not exist under the temp repo (`expectPaths: {present: [...], absent: [...]}`) and JSON fields of plan.json. Keep --assert-no-model and --verify-discriminating working for the new kind (the discriminator mutates a recording or a flag). Introduce `runPlanCase` as the runner for the command kind.

Change 2, the three cases: D23 (title 'a frozen plan never launches its contract'): recordings for draft and review, expected plan.json status frozen, contract.json present, and no .runs/<contract id>/ directory; discriminator: a recording that also creates the run directory would fail. D24 ('a contested plan emits no contract and names its findings'): every review recording returns a critical finding, --review-rounds 1, expected status contested, contract.json absent, findings listed, open-question in the journal. D25 ('a detached planning pipeline survives its launcher'): run `plan --detach`, kill the launching process once the bootstrap record exists (through the case's setup hook, never a raw kill of the test runner's own group), wait for plan.json, expected status frozen. No wall-clock bounds from above.

Change 3: evals/README.md gains a paragraph on command cases; `node evals/run.mjs --verify-fixtures` and `--validate-golden` must keep passing (evals/golden is never edited; if the golden set needs the new cases, follow the README's build-golden procedure and report what it changed).
decisions: Command cases reuse the deterministic class and its discriminator discipline.
Numeric ids keep the repository's convention; the proposal's D-plan names are the titles.
